headline.purpose: Page titles, sheet heads, project names, bug titles (1.25rem / 600).

body.purpose: Forms, prose, table titles, muted leads (0.875rem / 1.7).

label.purpose: Table headers, badges, chips, meta, crumbs (0.75rem).

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Cards, inbox groups, and stats at rest (--shadow).

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive card hover, menus, capture stage (--shadow-hover).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for transitions and entrances.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Alias of ease-out — no overshoot; used by sheets, menus, buttons.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Color, border, and small control transitions.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: Modal, sheet, and main rise entrances.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid next-step action — one per bug action row.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.875rem; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(21, 32, 51, 0.08); transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, opacity 160ms ease, transform 280ms var(--ease-spring), box-shadow 280ms var(--ease-spring); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(21, 32, 51, 0.16); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined ledger control for secondary paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(21, 32, 51, 0.05); transition: background 160ms ease, box-shadow 280ms var(--ease-spring), transform 280ms var(--ease-spring); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-2); box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(21, 32, 51, 0.1); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet text control for cancel / tertiary moves.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-muted); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: none; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive bug transition — always last in the row.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; background: var(--danger); color: var(--accent-ink); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(21, 32, 51, 0.08); transition: background 160ms ease, transform 280ms var(--ease-spring), box-shadow 280ms var(--ease-spring); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 85%, black); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(21, 32, 51, 0.16); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard ledger field — hairline border, accent on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-label { display: block; width: 100%; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-muted); margin-bottom: 0.35rem; } .ds-input { width: 100%; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, var(--line)); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Card
components.description: White ledger page — hover deepens shadow only.
components.html:
报障列表

按状态筛选，一眼看到该你处理的单。
components.css: .ds-card { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 94%, white); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 88%, white); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding: 1.3rem 1.4rem 1.35rem; font-family: var(--font); transition: box-shadow 200ms var(--ease-out), border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, var(--line)); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ink); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--ink-muted); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill with tinted fill — always includes Chinese status text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.18rem 0.65rem; font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-badge-awaiting { color: var(--status-awaiting); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-awaiting) 12%, white); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-awaiting) 25%, white); }

components.name: Attention Chip
components.description: Project card attention — hot only when count > 0; else quiet 暂无待办.
components.html: 3 待处理暂无待办
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-chip { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink-muted); background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; } .ds-chip-quiet { cursor: default; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-chip-hot { color: var(--status-pending); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-pending) 12%, white); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-pending) 22%, white); } .ds-chip-hot:hover { filter: brightness(0.98); } .ds-chip-hot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Topbar Nav
components.description: Sticky frosted shell brand + ghost nav with active wash.
components.html:
Bugboard
项目管理
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; min-height: 4.5rem; padding: 0.85rem clamp(1.15rem, 2vw, 2.25rem); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 80%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.2); font-family: var(--font); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) inset; } .ds-brand { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; margin-left: auto; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink-muted); text-decoration: none; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Bugboard is a daytime desktop work ledger for Chinese intranet operators. The interface reads like a shared paper book of tickets: calm blues and cool paper fields, one sans family (IBM Plex Sans + Noto Sans SC), and status language that a person can scan in seconds. Density stays operational — tables, sheets, chips, and one clear next action — never marketing chrome.

Personality is restrained Operate craft: precise, scannable, and quiet when there is nothing to do. Color carries state machine meaning, not decoration. Surfaces sit on a soft paper wash with a faint grid; cards and sheets are white ledger pages with a light ambient shadow. Motion eases out without spring overshoot. Confirmed rejections: no purple SaaS gradients, no cyber/terminal skin, no second display face.
keyCharacteristics: Single UI sans stack; Chinese-first labels and status names
Semantic color reserved for status, priority, and charts — not brand fills
One solid primary action per bug; destructive actions last
Attention chips and summary tiles stay quiet at zero
Card hover deepens shadow only (no lift translate)

rules.name: The Status-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Hue beyond neutrals and the single accent exists to name a state, priority, or series point — never to paint a marketing surface.

rules.name: The Quiet Zero Rule
rules.body: Project attention chips render only when count > 0; otherwise a quiet「暂无待办」chip. Summary tiles hide zero counts unless showAll=1.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a second UI family or a display serif. Mono is reserved for tokens and technical strings.

rules.name: The Shadow-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Card hover changes shadow and border only. Do not add card translateY on hover.

rules.name: The No-Overshoot Rule
rules.body: --ease-spring equals --ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)). Entrance animations ease out; they do not bounce past the end state. Honor prefers-reduced-motion.

dos: Do keep Chinese status names and one primary next action visible within ~10 seconds of opening a bug or project.
Do use --status-* / --priority-* tokens for badges, chips, and chart series only.
Do hide zero summary tiles unless the operator opts into showAll=1.
Do disable「立即发布」when the release queue is empty; keep「标记已发布」available as the ledger note path.
Do match motion to --ease-out / --ease-spring (identical curves) and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce purple SaaS gradients, neon/cyber terminal skins, or a second display typeface.
Don't invent decorative color blocks that do not map to a status, priority, or chart series.
Don't lift cards on hover or add spring overshoot to entrances.
Don't show a stack of equal-weight bug actions — one primary, danger last.
Don't rely on color alone for status; badge and chip copy stays required.
